title: 第12章 仙缘第13章 下跪
content_zh:
第12章仙缘
眼看仙师对自己找来的人很是不满，那虎镇嵩惶恐之极，连忙解释道：“溪平仙师容禀，这些人都是我猛虎帮精心挑选出来的，在开元府和西平府地界也都是顶尖的江湖人物，别看这两个出家人年纪大，他们的功力却一点都不比我差，剩下的那些人也都是各有所长，很适合进入那密地探险。”
听完虎镇嵩的话，那被称为溪平仙师的年轻人只是不耐烦的哼了一声，面无表情的说道：“跟我说这些没用，你还是想想怎么跟溪英师叔解释吧，你们迟迟不到，溪英师叔早就等得不耐烦了。”
那溪平仙师说完，身体轻轻一荡，就从树上飘落下来，然后几个闪身就消失在了前面，应该是给他口中的师叔报信去了。
虎镇嵩知道对方的话不假，如果不是等急了，对方也不可能专门派一个人守在这里。可他也是满肚子的委屈啊，从这里到西平府，紧赶慢赶也要五天的时间，来回就是十天，剩下的所有的准备工作才了不到五天时间，已经是压缩到了极点了。不过给仙师做事，有委屈也只能自己忍着。
眼见那溪平仙师已经入谷，虎镇嵩没有继续在外面等，而是直起身来，直接带着大家进入了谷中。山谷的入口处有一条小河，他们沿着小河继续往上走，又走了两三里地，来到一处开阔地带。
青阳向四周看了看，发现这开阔地带明显就是人为的造成的，原本生长在这里的树木杂草都已经被清理干净，还能看到地面上隐约露出的树桩。开阔地的后面是一处山壁，在山壁上离地一丈多高的位置有一个山洞，山洞的边缘整齐之极，显然是用利刃切削而成。
以猛虎帮的能力，虽然也能开凿这样的山洞，但那需要无数的匠人一凿一斧开辟出来，肯定不会留下这么明显的切削痕迹。虎镇嵩也可以运功用利器切削，但是一下两下可以，开山洞是不可能的，不光是功力跟不上，也没有这么耐用的利器。
看来这片开阔地以及那山洞都是仙师所为，开辟出来作为临时洞府使用的，至于是如何开凿的，就不是他们能够猜到的了。
那山洞距离他们并不远，但是入口处模模糊糊的，根本看不到里面究竟都有什么，也不知中间隔了一层什么东西。
就在大家观察那山洞的时候，忽然之间，山洞入口处荡起一阵光幕，随后三条人影就毫无征兆的出现在了山洞外面。
松鹤老道与空寂大师功力深厚，一般有什么动静都逃不过他们的眼睛，这一次却也没有看出对方之前隐藏在哪里，他们只能摇了摇头，把这一切归结为仙师无所不能。
连松鹤老道和空寂大师都是这样，其他人就更不用说了，至于那几个小孩，都和青阳一样，脸上满是羡慕，这也太神奇了，幻想着自己将来也有那一天。
山洞口的三条人影，站在最左边的那个正是从山谷入口处提前回来的那个溪平仙师，剩下的两个无论是穿着打扮，还是形象气质，都跟那个溪平仙师差不太多。只是中间那一个年龄更大一些，表情和气度看起来更沉稳一些，服色也更深一些。
大家都是老江湖了，不用介绍，都能判断的出来，中间那个应该就是那溪平仙师口中的溪英师叔了，至于右边的那个，身份地位应该跟溪平仙师差不到，不是师兄就是师弟。
那溪英师叔也是一副面无表情的样子，站在山洞入口处，只是往下轻轻扫了那么一眼，就把下面众人的情况都看在了眼中。
别看就是这么简单的一眼，却让下面的众人感觉仿佛过去了一个世纪一般，先是如山的压力扑面而来，沉闷的让人几乎透不过气，等到他们几乎坚持不住的时候，那压力才渐渐地消失。
压力还没有完全消失，周围忽然之间就变亮了，大家感觉自己就像是在大庭广众之下，忽然就被人扒光了衣服一般，四面八方都是目光，在肆无忌惮的打量着你，让你无所遁形，什么秘密都隐藏不住。
别说是青阳了，就算是他的师父松鹤老道和空寂大师也不例外，而且实力越强，感受到的压力反而越大。难怪猛虎帮的一众高手会对仙师如此敬畏，仙师的手段果然厉害。
刚才还有人觉得不过如此，仙师似乎也没有多么厉害，也就是轻功比大家高明一些，实力比江湖中人更强大一些罢了。现在算是彻底的服气了，他们之间根本就无法放在一起比。

那溪英师叔目光扫过众人，面无表情的道：“嗯，还行，这些人的实力虽然与我们修仙者无法比拟，但从他们的气息和身法来看，在普通人之中应该都是佼佼者。尤其是那两个出家人，就算是与我门派之中的开脉境中期杂役弟子相比，也不遑多让，看来在这件事上虎帮主还是用了一些心思的。”
青阳并不明白溪英仙师所说的开脉境中期杂役弟子是什么，但是对方仅仅靠着刚才那一道目光，就给了大家一个威慑，而且判断出了在场人的大致实力，这溪英仙师的本事已经比起初那个溪宁仙师高出了太多了，不愧是更高一级的师叔级人物。那溪宁仙师他们还能勉强仰望的到，面对这个溪英仙师就只有绝望了。
虎镇嵩与大家不同，他憋了满肚子的委屈，也做好了见面之后受到一番斥责的准备，结果的得到的竟然是一通夸奖，虎镇嵩顿时感激涕零，连忙跪在地上，冲着山洞位置郑重的磕了好几个头，才泣声道：“多谢仙师夸奖，我猛虎帮感激涕零，只要您一句话，我猛虎帮上上下下愿意为仙师赴汤蹈火在所不辞。”
见虎镇嵩如此知礼，那溪英仙师很是欣慰，脸上终于有了一丝笑容，他微微点了点头，道：“很好，这次的事情就交给虎帮主了，只要你圆满完成任务，我会赐给你猛虎帮一个仙缘的。”
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 12 Immortal Fate
Seeing that the Immortal Master was very dissatisfied with the people he had found, Nahu Zhensong was extremely frightened and quickly explained: "Xiping Immortal Master Rong Zhen, these people were carefully selected by our Tiger Gang. They are also top figures in the world of Kaiyuan Mansion and Xiping Mansion. Although these two monks are older, their skills are no worse than mine. The remaining people also have their own strengths and are very suitable for exploring that secret place."
After listening to Hu Zhensong's words, the young man known as Immortal Master Xiping just snorted impatiently and said expressionlessly: "It's useless to tell me this. You should think about how to explain it to Uncle Xiying. You guys are late, and Uncle Xiying has been impatient for a long time."
After the Immortal Master Xiping finished speaking, he swayed slightly and fell down from the tree. Then he disappeared in front of him in a few flashes. He should have gone to report the news to the uncle he mentioned.
Hu Zhensong knew that what the other party said was true. If he hadn't been in a hurry, the other party wouldn't have sent a person to guard here. But he was also full of grievances. It would take five days to go from here to Xiping Mansion, and ten days to go back and forth. All the remaining preparations took less than five days, and they were already compressed to the extreme. But when you work for an immortal master, you have to endure it yourself if you feel wronged.
Seeing that Immortal Master Xiping had entered the valley, Hu Zhensong did not continue to wait outside, but straightened up and led everyone directly into the valley. There was a small river at the entrance of the valley. They continued to walk up the river and walked another two or three miles until they came to an open area.
Qingyang looked around and found that this open area was obviously man-made. The trees and weeds that originally grew here have been cleared away, and tree stumps can still be seen vaguely exposed on the ground. Behind the open area is a mountain wall. There is a cave on the mountain wall more than ten feet above the ground. The edges of the cave are extremely neat, and they are obviously cut with sharp blades.
With the capabilities of the Tiger Gang, although it is possible to dig such a cave, it would require countless craftsmen to dig it out with chisels and axes, and it would certainly not leave such obvious cutting marks. Hu Zhensong can also use his skills to cut with sharp tools, but it can be done in one or two strokes. It is impossible to open a cave. Not only is his skill unable to keep up, but he also does not have such a durable sharp weapon.
It seems that this open area and the cave were created by the immortal master and used as a temporary cave. As for how they were dug, they could not guess.
The cave was not far away from them, but the entrance was so blurry that they couldn't see what was inside, and they didn't know what was there between them.
Just as everyone was observing the cave, suddenly, there was a curtain of light at the entrance of the cave, and then three figures appeared outside the cave without any warning.
Old Taoist Songhe and Master Kongji have profound skills, and usually no movement can escape their eyes. However, this time they did not see where the other party was hiding before. They could only shake their heads and attribute all this to the omnipotence of the immortal master.
Even Master Songhe and Master Kongji are like this, not to mention the others. As for those children, they are all the same as Qingyang, with envy on their faces. This is amazing, and they dream of having that day in the future.
Among the three figures at the entrance of the cave, the one standing on the far left is the Immortal Master Xiping who came back early from the entrance of the valley. The remaining two are similar to the Immortal Master Xiping in terms of dress, appearance and temperament. It's just that the one in the middle is older, his expression and demeanor look calmer, and his clothes are darker.
Everyone is old in the martial arts world. You can tell without any introduction. The one in the middle should be the Uncle Xiying mentioned by Immortal Master Xiping. As for the one on the right, his status should be no different from that of Immortal Master Xiping. He is either a senior brother or a junior brother.
Uncle Na XiyingHe also had an expressionless look on his face. He stood at the entrance of the cave and just glanced downwards, taking in the situation of everyone below.
Even though it was such a simple look, it made the people below feel as if a century had passed. First, a mountain of pressure hit their faces, so dull that it was almost breathless. When they could hardly hold on, the pressure gradually disappeared.
Before the pressure completely disappeared, the surroundings suddenly became brighter. Everyone felt as if their clothes were suddenly stripped off in front of a large public. There were eyes from all directions, looking at you unscrupulously, leaving you with nothing to hide and no secrets to hide.
Not to mention Qingyang, even his master Songhe Laodao and Master Kongji are no exception, and the stronger they are, the greater the pressure they feel. No wonder the masters of the Tiger Gang are so in awe of the Immortal Master, the Immortal Master's methods are really powerful.
Some people just thought that it was just that, and the immortal master didn't seem to be that powerful, that is, his light skills were better than everyone else's, and his strength was stronger than those in the world. Now that they are completely convinced, there is no way they can be compared together.
Uncle Xiying glanced at everyone and said expressionlessly: "Well, it's okay. Although the strength of these people is incomparable to us cultivators, judging from their aura and body skills, they should be the best among ordinary people. Especially those two monks, even compared with the mid-level servant disciples in the Kaikai realm in our sect, they are not far behind. It seems that the leader of the Tiger Gang has put some thought into this matter."
Qingyang didn't understand what Immortal Master Xi Ying meant as a handyman disciple in the middle stage of the Opening Pulse Realm, but the other party gave everyone a deterrent just by looking at him, and judged the general strength of the people present. The ability of Immortal Master Xi Ying was already much higher than that of Immortal Master Xi Ning at the beginning, and he was worthy of being a higher-level uncle-level figure. Immortal Master Xi Ning and the others could barely look up at him, but facing Immortal Master Xi Ying, they could only feel despair.
Hu Zhensong was different from everyone else. He had suppressed his grievances and was prepared to be scolded after meeting. However, what he got was a lot of praise. Hu Zhensong immediately burst into tears of gratitude and quickly knelt on the ground. He kowtowed several times solemnly to the location of the cave, and then cried out: "Thank you very much for the compliment from the Immortal Master. We in the Tiger Gang are very grateful. As long as you say a word, everyone in the Tiger Gang is willing to go through fire and water for the Immortal Master."
Master Na Xiying was very pleased to see that Hu Zhensong knew etiquette so well. There was finally a smile on his face. He nodded slightly and said: "Very good, this matter will be left to the leader of the Tiger Gang. As long as you successfully complete the task, I will give you a fairy fate from the Tiger Gang."
(End of chapter)
